===Format===
* '''Group Stage:'''
** 16 Team Swiss System Format
*** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** Top 8 teams proceed to Playoffs
** {{Swiss Explained/ESL 2025}}

* '''Playoffs:'''
** Single-Elimination bracket
** All matches ''(excl. Grand Final)'' are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
** The Grand Final is {{Abbr/Bo5}}
